Game Overview

Gluttonous Snake puts players into a snake experience centered on guide your ever-growing snake to devour food while avoiding self-collision in a nostalgic throwback to classic mobile gaming. Strategize your moves within limited space, balancing between collecting points and ensuring survival. Simple mechanics paired with addictive challenges promise endless entertainment and high-score pursuits.
